description: Total Load Profiles by Balancing Authority in the Western United States for GODEEEP is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Casey Burleyson, Travis Thurber (Pacific Northwest National Laboratory). This dataset contains time-series of total load profiles across Balancing Authorities (BAs) in the western United States (U.S.) electricity grid interconnection for the years 2025, 2030, 2035, 2040, 2045, and 2050. The data is provided for two different socioeconomic pathways and one climate scenario. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
